title.en: An Act Providing Uniform Units of Volume or Weight in Tradings in Rice and Palay.

text.en:
All tradings in rice and palay, not including bearded and unthreshed palay in straw and in
bundles, shall be conducted on the basis of the liter, the kilogram, the sack, or the ganta. Exclusive of the
weight of the containers, each sack of rice shall weigh at least fifty-six kilograms and each sack of palay at
least forty-four kilograms. The ganta shall contain three liters.

Any person, firm, or corporation engaged in the milling, selling, buying, or bartering rice or
palay shall use only containers clearly marked with the volume
or weight as well as the kind or variety of the rice or palay milled, sold, bought, or bartered. These marks,
preferably in print, shall be made in letters and figures of not less than two inches in height.

Anyone engaged in the milling, selling, buying, or bartering of rice or palay who violates any
provision of this Act shall be punished by a fine of not less than one hundred pesos and not more than five
hundred pesos, or imprisonment for not less than fifteen days and not more than three months, or both. If the
violation is committed by a firm or corporation, the manager, managing director, or person charged with the
management of the business of such firm or corporation shall be criminally responsible therefor.

This Act shall take effect three months after its approval.
Approved, June 4. 1941.
